Your Information

Privacy Policy for B2B Enquiries

This page explains how Asmitha Paper Agency uses information shared through this website.

Information we receive

We may receive your name, company name, phone number, email address, location, delivery location, and product requirements when you contact us or request a quote.

How we use it

We use this information to answer enquiries, prepare quotations, confirm product requirements, arrange delivery, and communicate about your order.

WhatsApp enquiries

When you submit a quote, the website prepares a WhatsApp message for you to review. WhatsApp handles the message according to its own privacy policy. You choose whether to send it.

Sharing information

We do not sell your personal information. We share details only when needed to respond to your request, process an order, or arrange delivery.

Questions

Contact us if you want to ask about the information you have shared with Asmitha Paper Agency.
